dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: My work with the Ministry of Civil Affairs has really been piling up recently. Right now I'm assigning them to people.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I just finished organizing forms that I need various people to fill out, but I don't have any time to distribute them...

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: You'd do that? Great! It's really not complicated. Everything I need is written very clearly on the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Just take them the forms and they'll see what they need to do.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: The two most urgent jobs are those for Jiangzhou and Nervous An. Take these forms to them.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Come back here and let me know once you've delivered the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: No, it's not complicated, really! I already wrote everything out on the forms.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: You just deliver the forms and you're done. Simple as that.

response.speaker: Clerk Zhao
response.text: Thank you so much. I'm just swamped with work now.
